metadata.description: Globally unique name for the app. It becomes the web address: https://<name>.azurewebsites.net
Azure region. Defaults to the resource group's region.
A secret phrase you choose now and type in when you first open the app, to create the owner account. It stops anyone else from claiming a freshly deployed instance. At least 12 characters.
App Service plan size. B1 is plenty for a household; "Always On" keeps the background jobs running, so the Free tier is not offered.
Container image. Leave as is unless you are testing a specific version.
Only needed while the image is private: a GitHub username with access to it.
Only needed while the image is private: a GitHub token with the read:packages scope.
IANA time zone used for scheduled jobs and logs, e.g. Europe/London.

siteConfig.appSettings: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'WEBSITES_ENABLE_APP_SERVICE_STORAGE', 'value', 'true'), createObject('name', 'WEBSITES_PORT', 'value', '3000'), createObject('name', 'WEBSITES_CONTAINER_START_TIME_LIMIT', 'value', '600'), createObject('name', 'DATA_DIR', 'value', '/home/poketracker'), createObject('name', 'PUBLIC_URL', 'value', format('https://{0}.azurewebsites.net', parameters('appName'))), createObject('name', 'TRUST_PROXY', 'value', '1'), createObject('name', 'SQLITE_JOURNAL_MODE', 'value', 'delete'), createObject('name', 'SETUP_TOKEN', 'value', parameters('setupToken')), createObject('name', 'TZ', 'value', parameters('timeZone'))), if(variables('usePrivateRegistry'), createArray(createObject('name', 'DOCKER_REGISTRY_SERVER_URL', 'value', 'https://ghcr.io'), createObject('name', 'DOCKER_REGISTRY_SERVER_USERNAME', 'value', parameters('registryUsername')), createObject('name', 'DOCKER_REGISTRY_SERVER_PASSWORD', 'value', parameters('registryPassword'))), createArray()))]
